theater: 北高加索車臣地區與格羅茲尼

battle.name: 第一次車臣戰爭
battle.theater: 北高加索車臣地區與格羅茲尼
battle.brief: 一九九四年十二月十一日，兩萬餘名俄軍自西、西北、東三面越境攻入車臣，格羅茲尼守軍一萬五千人據城死守，戰事延續到一九九六年八月。卡面的1862年鐵甲艦指向海上那一面：聯合司令部裡設有海軍作戰組，裏海艦隊在西北岸執行封鎖與巡邏，裝甲護艦的傳統最終落在小型導彈炮艇與氣墊登陸艇上。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 交戰的一方是俄羅斯聯邦，實際投入的是「聯邦部隊聯合集群」：國防部第58集團軍、第29集團軍所屬部隊與北高加索軍區各兵團，內務部內務部隊（OMON與SOBR特種作戰部隊），邊防部隊，以及聯邦反情報局（後改組為FSB）直屬的阿爾法、維佳茲等特種分隊。聯合司令部設在北高加索軍區司令部，參謀序列裡還有航空兵、傘兵、總參情報部與海軍的作戰組。另一方是未獲承認的車臣共和國伊奇克里亞武裝，杜達耶夫執政時以武裝民兵、內務部隊殘餘與蘇軍散兵為骨幹，參謀長馬什哈多夫、車臣安全局局長伊斯梅洛夫、地方指揮蓋拉耶夫與巴巴耶夫各領兵一部，另有哈塔卜率領的外籍武裝；一九九四年伊斯梅洛夫帶着安全局人員與總統衛隊倒向莫斯科。俄方還扶植了第三股力量：烏馬爾·阿夫圖爾哈諾夫領導的反杜達耶夫派，一九九四年夏天起在北高加索大打，替莫斯科消耗車臣的兵力。海上一線同樣有布置：裏海艦隊在西北岸執行封鎖與巡邏，聯合司令部的參謀序列裡就有海軍作戰組的位置。
countriesEn: One side was the Russian Federation, which committed what was formally called the Joint Grouping of Federal Forces: the 58th Army, units of the 29th Army and the formations of the North Caucasus Military District from the Ministry of Defence, the Interior Troops of the Ministry of Internal Affairs (OMON and the special-purpose units of SOBR), the Border Troops, and the special detachments of the Federal Security Service (still FSK at the time, later reorganised as the FSB), including the Alpha and Vityaz groups. The joint command was formed on the base of the North Caucasus Military District staff, and its order of battle also contained operational groups of the air force, the airborne troops, the Main Intelligence Directorate of the General Staff and the navy. The other side was the armed forces of the unrecognised Chechen Republic of Ichkeria: under Dzhokhar Dudayev they were built on armed militia, the remnants of the interior troops and scattered regular army soldiers, with the chief of staff Aslan Maskhadov, the head of the Chechen security service Aslanbek Ismailov, and the field commanders Ruslan Gelayev and Shamil Basayev each commanding a part of them, joined by foreign fighters under Khattab; in 1994 Ismailov crossed to Moscow with his security-service men and the presidential guard. Moscow also propped up a third party, the anti-Dudayev opposition under Umar Avturkhanov, which fought through the northern Caucasus from the summer of 1994 and wore down the separatist forces on Russia's behalf. The sea line was laid out as well: the Caspian Flotilla enforced the blockade and patrolled the north-western shore, and the navy held an operational group inside the joint command.
people: 決策分在莫斯科與格羅茲尼兩端。葉爾欽一九九四年十一月三十日簽署第2137號秘密命令，授權以「恢復憲法秩序」名義用兵；國防部長格拉喬夫隨即在十二月一日於邊境組建集群，卻聲稱只要一個空降團、二十天就能收場。首任聯合集群司令、北高加索軍區司令米秋欣在戰役全面展開時被撤，第一副總司令埃杜阿爾德·沃羅比約夫以「毫無準備」為由拒絕出任指揮並遞交辭職報告，十二月二十日由克瓦什寧接任。真正主導格羅茲尼巷戰的是內務部長庫利科夫，他事後公開指參謀部把同一天陣亡的四十人報成十五人。沃羅比約夫一九九五年一月七日轉移指揮所時被迫擊砲擊斃，是最早陣亡的將領之一。車臣一方，總統杜達耶夫於一九九六年四月二十一日被俄方導彈擊殺；參謀長馬什哈多夫策劃了八月六日的「聖戰」反攻，並在八月三十一日簽署哈薩尤爾特協議；巴巴耶夫在沙托伊與韋杰諾一線據守，蓋拉耶夫死守鄉鎮與陣地，哈塔卜在阿爾古恩峽谷設伏打掉俄方整個團的裝甲縱隊。海軍方面，一九九一至一九九六年裏海艦隊由海軍中將齊寧指揮，聯合司令部裡的海軍作戰組即出自其編成。
peopleEn: The decisions were made in two places, Moscow and Grozny. On 30 November 1994 Boris Yeltsin signed secret decree No. 2137, authorising the use of arms in the name of restoring constitutional legality, and the defence minister Pavel Grachev assembled the grouping at the border on 1 December while claiming that a single airborne regiment and twenty days would be enough to finish the job. The first commander of the Joint Grouping, Colonel-General Anatoly Mityukhin of the North Caucasus Military District, was removed as the campaign unfolded, and the first deputy commander-in-chief of the ground forces, Eduard Vorobyov, declined to take command on the grounds that the operation was wholly unprepared and tendered his resignation instead; on 20 December Anatoly Kvashnin took over. The man who actually directed the street fighting in Grozny was the interior minister Anatoly Kulikov, who later said in public that the staff had reported fifteen men killed on a single day when the true figure was forty. Vorobyov was killed by mortar fire while shifting his command post on 7 January 1995, one of the first generals to die. On the Chechen side President Dzhokhar Dudayev was killed on 21 April 1996 by a Russian guided missile; chief of staff Aslan Maskhadov planned the Operation Jihad counter-offensive of 6 August and signed the Khasavyurt Accord on 31 August; Basayev held the Shatoy and Vedeno lines, Gelayev fought to hold towns and positions, and Khattab ambushed a Russian regiment column in the Argun Gorge and destroyed its armour. At sea, the Caspian Flotilla was under Vice Admiral Zinin from 1991 to 1996, and the naval operational group inside the joint command was built out of his fleet.
kits: 卡面是1862年的鐵甲艦：木殼外面包了鐵，裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。這條技術路線在一九九四年的裏海艦隊身上仍看得到——巡洋艦與小型炮艇的外殼同樣靠防護吃住反艦導彈的碎片與機炮火力，氣墊登陸艇更把鐵甲從水面搬到沙灘；但整場車臣戰爭真正交火的全是內陸裝備。俄方有T-72與T-80坦克、BMP-1與BMP-2步兵戰車、BTR-60與BTR-70裝甲輸送車、2S1「花椒」自行榴彈炮、2S3「向日葵」自行榴彈炮、122毫米D-30榴彈炮、BM-21「冰雹」多管火箭炮、Mi-24「鱷魚」武裝直升機、Mi-8與Mi-8MT系列直升機、Su-24與Su-25飛機。車臣方以AKM與AK-74自動步槍、PKM通用機槍、DShK重機槍與RPG-7火箭筒為主力，另有蘇聯解體時流出的T-34/85與T-54/55坦克、翻修的BTR-60輸送車、改裝卡車（當地稱「技術車」）與車載ZU-23-2高射機槍；炮兵方面以繳獲的榴彈炮和冰雹火箭炮湊數，射擊精度與射表幾乎全靠臨場估算。
kitsEn: The card shows the ironclad of 1862: an iron skin wrapped over a wooden hull, armour for the first time harder to defeat than guns, after which turret design revolved around it. The same technical line is visible in the Caspian Flotilla of 1994, where the hulls of the cruisers and small gunboats relied on protection against fragments and machine-gun fire, and where air-cushion landing craft carried the ironclad idea from the water onto the sand; but everything that actually exchanged fire in the Chechen war was land equipment. On the Russian side were T-72 and T-80 tanks, BMP-1 and BMP-2 infantry fighting vehicles, BTR-60 and BTR-70 armoured personnel carriers, the 2S1 Gvozdika and 2S3 Akatsiya self-propelled howitzers, 122 mm D-30 howitzers, BM-21 Grad multiple rocket launchers, Mi-24 Hind attack helicopters, Mi-8 and Mi-8MT series helicopters, and Su-24 and Su-25 aircraft. The Chechen side fought with AKM and AK-74 assault rifles, PKM general-purpose machine guns, DShK heavy machine guns and RPG-7 launchers, together with T-34/85 and T-54/55 tanks that had flowed out of Soviet arsenals at the collapse of the USSR, rebuilt BTR-60 carriers, improvised trucks known locally as technicals, and ZU-23-2 anti-aircraft guns mounted on them; their artillery was made up of captured howitzers and Grad launchers, with firing tables and sight settings worked out on the spot.
tactics: 俄軍的戰術主軸是三面縱深推進加合圍：西線自北奧塞梯亞經印古什向格羅茲尼推進，北線自莫茲多克沿捷列克河南下，東線自達吉斯坦的基茲利亞爾沿草原迂迴，一九九四年十二月十一日三個集群同時越境，十九日發動新攻勢，二十日莫茲多克集群佔領多林斯基，104空降兵團從阿爾古恩峽谷方向封住城市北面；三十一日以「北」「東北」「西」「東」四個集群強攻格羅茲尼，一九九五年二月三日才組成「南」集群完成南面包圍，至二月九日推進到羅斯托夫—巴庫公路一線。巷戰裡約250輛裝甲車湧入街區，狹窄街道讓坦克無法展開，步兵與坦克失去協同，遂改由炮兵與航空兵逐段清剿；山地則靠傘兵與特種部隊小組空降插入敵後，十二月三十一日在科姆索莫爾斯克與謝爾任-尤爾特兩地分別空降第22獨立特種旅與第67獨立特種旅的分隊，負責引導炮火、設伏破壞道路並布雷。車臣方的做法是據點防禦加小組狙擊：據守火車站、總統府與蘇日阿河畔的分層工事，以RPG伏擊縱隊首尾，選擇道路與峽谷的狹窄處下手，一九九六年四月十六日在阿爾古恩峽谷的雅雷什馬爾迪村擊毀第245近衛摩步團縱隊的全部裝甲。海軍在車臣只承擔封鎖、巡邏與邊境控制，未有正面投入。
tacticsEn: The Russian plan was deep advance on three axes plus a blockade: the western column came from North Ossetia through Ingushetia, the northern column down the Terek from Mozdok, and the eastern column swung round through the Dagestan steppe from Kizlyar, all three crossing the border on 11 December 1994. A new offensive began on the 19th, the Mozdok group took Dolinsky on the 20th, and the 104th Guards Air Assault Regiment sealed the northern approach through the Argun Gorge. On 31 December the storm of Grozny went in with four groups named North, North-East, West and East, and only on 3 February 1995 was a South group formed to close the southern side, reaching the Rostov-Baku highway by 9 February. In the streets some 250 armoured vehicles pushed into the built-up area, where narrow streets left the tanks unable to deploy and broke the cooperation between armour and infantry, so the fight was carried on instead by artillery and aircraft, block by block. In the mountains, spetsnaz groups were inserted behind enemy lines by helicopter: on 31 December combined detachments of the 22nd and 67th Separate Special Purpose Brigades were airlifted in near Komsomolskoye and near Serzhen-Yurt, to spot for the guns, lay ambushes and mine the roads. The Chechens fought by fortified positions and small-team marksmanship: holding the railway station, the presidential palace and the layered positions along the Sunzha, ambushing the head and tail of armoured columns with RPGs and choosing ground where the road or the gorge was narrow; on 16 April 1996 they destroyed the whole armour of a 245th Guards Motor Rifle Regiment column near the village of Yarishmardy in the Argun Gorge. The navy played no frontal part, confining itself to the blockade, to patrol and to control the sea frontier.
data: 可以確定的第一組數字是一九九四年十二月十一日越境時的編成：三個集群合計23,800人，其中國防部19,100人、內務部隊4,700人，配80輛坦克、208輛步戰機與裝甲輸送車、182門火砲與迫擊砲、140架作戰飛機、55架直升機；同一份編制在十二月投入的作戰飛機總數為515架，到一九九五年二月，全部部署兵力被統計為70,500人。車臣武裝方面，一九九四年的估計在13,500至15,000人之間，一九九四年十二月約20,000人，一九九五年一月一度被估為30,000人，一九九五年二月回落至15,000至17,000人，到一九九六年八月俄方估計已達40,000人，而車臣自己的說法是6,000人。作戰數字上，一九九五年一月一日強攻格羅茲尼時，第131獨立摩步旅作戰地區有85人陣亡、72人失蹤，20輛坦克被毀，旅長薩文上校陣亡，100餘人被俘，第81近衛摩步團一個加強營到一月一日僅剩三成編制；一九九六年四月十六日阿爾古恩峽谷的伏擊戰中，第245近衛摩步團縱隊的裝甲全部損失，半數人員折損。俄軍全期損失，聯合集群作戰指揮部公布為陣亡4,103人、失蹤逃亡與被俘合計1,231人、受傷19,794人，軍事史家克里沃謝耶夫統計為陣亡5,042人、失蹤690人、受傷17,892人，另有士兵母親委員會指陣亡人數不少於14,000人；車臣方面的陣亡數字則有俄方公佈的17,391人、內務部一九九五年十一月公佈的10,000至15,000人、紀念協會的2,700人與車臣自己的約3,000人等版本。
dataEn: The first set of numbers that can be pinned down is the order of battle on 11 December 1994, the day of the crossing: the three groups together numbered 23,800 men, of whom 19,100 came from the armed forces and 4,700 from the Interior Troops, with 80 tanks, 208 infantry fighting vehicles and armoured carriers, 182 guns and mortars, 140 combat aircraft and 55 helicopters; the same order of battle counted 515 combat aircraft in service in December 1994, and by February 1995 the total deployed force was reckoned at 70,500 men. On the Chechen side the estimates ran from 13,500 to 15,000 in 1994, about 20,000 in December 1994, put as high as 30,000 in January 1995, back to between 15,000 and 17,000 in February 1995 and 40,000 by August 1996 according to the Russian side, while the Chechens themselves put the figure at 6,000. On the fighting itself, in the assault of 1 January 1995 the 131st Separate Motor Rifle Brigade lost 85 men killed and 72 missing in its sector, 20 tanks were destroyed, the brigade commander Colonel Savin was killed and more than a hundred men taken prisoner, and by 1 January a reinforced battalion of the 81st Guards Motor Rifle Regiment had been reduced to thirty per cent of its strength; in the ambush of 16 April 1996 in the Argun Gorge the 245th Guards Motor Rifle Regiment column lost all of its armour and half of its men. For the campaign as a whole the Joint Grouping operations staff reported 4,103 men killed, 1,231 missing, deserted or captured, and 19,794 wounded; the military historian Krivosheev counted 5,042 killed, 690 missing and 17,892 wounded, while the Committee of Soldiers' Mothers put the number of dead at no less than 14,000. The Chechen dead are given in several versions: 17,391 on Russian data, 10,000 to 15,000 as announced by the Interior Ministry in November 1995, 2,700 by the Memorial organisation, and about 3,000 on the Chechen side's own account.
cause: 直接起因是蘇聯解體後車臣主權與獨立的宣示。一九九一年十月，車臣最高蘇維埃選舉前蘇聯空軍將軍杜達耶夫出任總統；一九九二年車臣宣佈主權，一九九三年正式宣佈獨立，成為車臣共和國伊奇克里亞。莫斯科起初並不打算立刻動武，反而在一九九三至一九九四年間資助反對派武裝向格羅茲尼進攻，一九九四年八月反對派一度攻入城內，外界以為杜達耶夫政權即將垮台，反而讓他撐過最危險的一關，同時消耗了車臣的骨幹。一九九四年十月與十一月二十六至二十七日的兩次進攻都告失敗。一九九三年十二月二十九日格羅茲尼市中心市場的轟炸事件把衝突推向不可收拾，一九九四年十一月二十九日葉爾欽發出最後通牒，三十日簽署第2137號秘密命令，十二月一日起對全境實施大規模空襲，十一日地面部隊越境。
causeEn: The immediate cause lay in the declaration of sovereignty and independence by Chechnya after the dissolution of the Soviet Union. In October 1991 Dzhokhar Dudayev, a former Soviet air force general, was elected president by the Supreme Soviet of Chechnya; in 1992 Chechnya declared sovereignty and in 1993 full independence, becoming the Chechen Republic of Ichkeria. Moscow did not at first intend to resort to arms, and in 1993 and 1994 instead financed opposition armed groups against Grozny; in August 1994 the opposition entered the city, and the expectation that the Dudayev government was about to fall in fact let him survive his most dangerous moment while wearing out the Chechen cadres. The attempts of October 1994 and of 26 to 27 November 1994 both failed. The bombing of the central market in Grozny on 29 December 1993 pushed the conflict out of control; on 29 November 1994 Yeltsin issued his ultimatum, signed secret decree No. 2137 on the 30th, began massive air strikes across the republic on 1 December, and the ground forces crossed the border on the 11th.
impact: 戰爭的後果遠超出車臣本身。一九九五年春天聯邦軍控制了格羅茲尼與北部低地，但山地游擊戰一直延續到一九九六年，戰術勝利沒有換來政治成果：一九九六年八月六日車臣武裝發動「聖戰」行動，一千五百名武裝人員滲透格羅茲尼，奪回阿爾古恩與古傑爾梅斯，第276摩托化團在兩日馳援中損失五成，聯邦軍用盡攻城手段仍未能奪回市中心。八月十九日普利科夫斯基的最後通牒被總統特使列別德譏為「壞玩笑」，八月三十一日簽署哈薩尤爾特協議，聯邦軍須在一九九六年十二月三十一日前全部撤出，車臣地位問題延至二〇〇一年再議。一九九七年五月十二日，葉爾欽與馬什哈多夫在莫斯科簽署和平條約，同年十一月雙方簽訂經濟關係與賠償協議，一九九七年二月俄方通過對雙方作戰人員的大赦。裏海艦隊的任務也隨之轉向，一九九〇年代末起其海軍陸戰隊分隊常態化守備車臣—達吉斯坦邊境與格魯吉亞邊界。戰爭同樣暴露了聯邦軍的裝備侷限：軍用通信未加密、城鎮地形下的裝甲與步兵協同失敗、飛機與火砲在城市裡的火力運用失控，這些教訓在此後的軍改中一一被重講。一九九九年夏天第二場車臣戰爭爆發，一九九六年的協議被撕毀。
impactEn: The consequences of the war reached far beyond Chechnya itself. In the spring of 1995 the federal forces held Grozny and the northern lowlands, but the guerrilla war in the mountains ran on into 1996, and tactical victory brought no political result: on 6 August 1996 the Chechen armed forces launched Operation Jihad, some 1,500 fighters infiltrated Grozny, took Argun and Gudermes, and the 276th Motorized Regiment lost half its strength in a two-day attempt to reach the city centre; the federal side failed to retake the centre of the capital even after every means of siege. The ultimatum of 19 August issued by Pulikovsky was dismissed by the presidential envoy Lebed as a bad joke, and on 31 August the Khasavyurt Accord was signed: all federal forces were to be withdrawn by 31 December 1996 and the status of Chechnya was deferred to 2001. On 12 May 1997 Yeltsin and Maskhadov signed the formal treaty in Moscow, in November of the same year the two sides concluded agreements on economic relations and reparations, and in February 1997 Russia approved an amnesty for Russian soldiers and Chechen fighters alike. The tasks of the Caspian Flotilla changed with the settlement; from the late 1990s its marine units permanently covered the Chechnya-Dagestan border and the frontier with Georgia. The war also exposed the limits of the federal equipment: unencrypted military communications, the failure of armour and infantry to work together in built-up country, and the loss of control of aircraft and artillery fire inside a city. Each of these lessons was taught again in the reform of the armed forces that followed. In the summer of 1999 a second Chechen war began, and the agreement of 1996 was torn up.
result: 結果是聯邦軍一九九五年三月控制格羅茲尼南區，四月十五日以縱隊長驅進入南部山區，五月先後拿下阿爾古恩與古傑爾梅斯，但清剿山區的努力在沙托伊、韋杰諾與達爾戈一線被拖住；一九九五年十月六日聯合集群司令羅曼諾夫在爆炸中重傷，攻勢整體停滯。一九九六年三月六日車臣武裝滲入格羅茲尼奪取軍火，四月十六日又在阿爾古恩峽谷打掉一個團的縱隊，六月十日納茲蘭會談達成撤軍框架。形勢逆轉的頂點是一九九六年八月六日的「聖戰」行動：車臣武裝一度奪回首都與兩個重要市鎮，聯邦軍損失慘重而無法逆轉，軍方情報被認為失準。八月十九日普利科夫斯基的最後通牒未果，葉爾欽的總統特使、退役上將列別德接手斡旋，八月三十一日與馬什哈多夫簽署哈薩尤爾特協議，聯邦軍一九九六年十二月三十一日前撤出，車臣地位延至二〇〇一年。一九九七年一月馬什哈多夫當選伊奇克里亞總統，五月和平條約簽署。多數研究把這場戰爭判為車臣的戰術勝利與俄羅斯的失敗：聯邦軍的目標——解除武裝、恢復聯邦管治——並未達成。
resultEn: The outcome was that federal forces took the southern part of Grozny in March 1995, drove in long columns into the southern mountains on 15 April and had taken Argun and Gudermes by May, but the attempt to clear the mountains was bogged down on the Shatoy, Vedeno and Dargo lines; on 6 October 1995 General Romanov, commander of the Joint Grouping, was critically wounded in an explosion and the offensive stalled as a whole. On 6 March 1996 Chechen fighters infiltrated Grozny and seized weapons caches, on 16 April they destroyed another regiment column in the Argun Gorge, and on 10 June the talks at Nazran produced a framework for withdrawal. The high point of the reversal was Operation Jihad of 6 August 1996, when the Chechen armed forces briefly retook the capital and two important towns, the federal side took heavy losses and could not reverse the situation, and the military intelligence was judged to have misread the enemy. The ultimatum of 19 August issued by Pulikovsky produced nothing, and Yeltsin's presidential envoy, the retired general Lebed, took over the mediation, signing the Khasavyurt Accord with Maskhadov on 31 August: the federal forces would be out by 31 December 1996 and the status of Chechnya deferred to 2001. In January 1997 Maskhadov was elected president of Ichkeria, and the peace treaty was signed in May. Most studies judge the war a tactical victory for Chechnya and a defeat for Russia: the federal objectives, disarming the separatists and restoring federal administration, were not achieved.
